beats.what: An invigilator seizes Lynn on the Redfern platform and orders her back to the test centre while she swallows the last of the evidence
An official tells Lynn that another Thai candidate has confessed to smuggling in a phone, so her score will be cancelled and she must sit the exam again
Lynn watches through the glass while Bank is questioned alone, then lowers her head and turns away from him
Pat and Grace meet Lynn at the airport with their scores and the news that Bank has been arrested, and invite her to a party
Lynn refuses to apply for a new exam, tells Pat and Grace the score is theirs, and walks past them
Lynn's father finds her waiting outside the terminal and she breaks down sobbing in his arms
Questioned alone in a bare white room, Lynn says she applied because she wants to teach like her father and admits she has taught others a special lesson
Pat messages that Bank has already collected his million and her cut is waiting, and Lynn leaves the chat
A signed school letter ends Bank's scholarship and he goes back to working the laundry alone
Bank's message brings Lynn to the laundry at night, past a school shirt scrawled with abuse, to a shop rebuilt with new machines and a new sign bought with his payoff
Bank pitches a bigger operation on the GATPAT exam, asks Lynn to be the teacher, and offers her all the money he has left
Bank threatens that if Lynn refuses he will tell everything, cancelling Grace's, Pat's and every customer's score and shaming her father
Lynn sits beside her bowed father in a white corridor and he lifts his head to give her a small smile
Lynn crosses to the door, looks back once and walks out of the laundry, refusing Bank's offer
Lynn is led to a camcorder and asked if she is ready to confess to the STIC cheating, with Bank and her father giving statements of their own
